title.hr: Rokovi za prijavu incidenta: 24 sata, 72 sata, mjesec dana
title.en: Incident reporting clocks: 24 hours, 72 hours, one month

concept.hr: Rokovi kreću sa saznanjem, ne s napadom, i teku kroz noći i vikende
concept.en: The clocks start at awareness, not at the attack, and run through weekends

summary.hr: Postavi incident na tjedan: napad, otkrivanje, trijaža. Saznanje pokreće rokove NIS2 i GDPR-a; petak navečer i spora trijaža ruše rok od 24 sata.
summary.en: Place an incident on a week: attack, detection, triage. Awareness starts the NIS2 and GDPR clocks; a Friday evening or a slow triage misses the 24 hours.

concept.hr: Rok od 24 sata istječe u subotu, a prijava čeka ponedjeljak
concept.en: The 24 hours run out on Saturday; the report waits for Monday
